findings.candidate_quote: However, the study did not establish causality, and the findings are based on observational and experimental associations.
findings.reference_quote: P301S transgenic mice were randomly divided into PBS-treated group and B. coccoides -treated group (n = 6/group).
findings.explanation: This blanket disclaimer misclassifies controlled interventions as associations. Randomized bacterial supplementation and manipulated-cell rescue experiments provide causal evidence within experimental models. They do not establish human disease causation or treatment efficacy, but that limitation does not negate the experimental causal evidence.
